transformations.description: Uses the full operator stop code, including BND/FIN/VIL prefix, as the stable StopNode suffix and creates singleton StopPlaces for new identities.
Stores four official ida/vuelta lists independently with closesLoop false and never infers reverse edges.
Models the current official route-page order captured on 2026-08-04, which reflects the temporary July 2026 Line 002/003 works route alignment. The pre-works route is not reconstructed.

Selects the full BND 385 to FIN 617 and FIN 617 to BND 385 ordered lists as the canonical Line 003 representation; timetable-supported early short workings at VIL 703 are recorded but not modeled as sequential alternative patterns.
Reuses 35 complete StopNode and StopPlace objects byte-semantically from benidorm-legacy-core-v1; creates 74 new composite identities.
Uses 35 exact accepted positions, 66 explicit address/corridor anchors, and 8 ordered-route interpolations. New coordinates remain development-stage review items.
Adds exactly one catalog descriptor and recomputes asset and aggregate SHA-256 values from serialized bytes.

Renames package identity from benidorm-legacy-core-west-v1 to benidorm-radial-core-west-v1 without changing route/pattern objects, StopNode/StopPlace identities, coordinates, or settlement assignments.

warnings: The project-owner naming policy uses legacy, while ordered route evidence is a current 2026 capture.
The Line 002 and 003 source pages reflect a temporary July 2026 works route alignment. This package is a dated topology snapshot, not a claim about the permanent post-works network.
Line 003 has timetable-supported early short workings beginning or ending at VIL 703; they are recorded in provenance and not represented as sequential alternative patterns on the canonical Route.

New FIN and VIL identities are assigned to Finestrat and La Vila Joiosa respectively from the operator composite prefix; exact municipal-boundary review remains appropriate for mixed Cala corridor stops.
New address/corridor and interpolated coordinates are explicitly provisional. Identity-preserving exact-source replacement is required before treating geography as authoritative.
Different composite stop codes remain separate StopNodes and singleton StopPlaces even when names or positions are close.
StopNode.sourceReferences is empty for new nodes because no individual OSM platform/stop_position object was adopted as strict runtime evidence.
